title: Trained transcoder decoder atoms as shared functional experts
hypothesis: A 16-atom basis selected from a task-trained sparse transcoder's 2048 decoder atoms can express the 16 relation-task FVs within .10 gold-logprob nats/.05 accuracy of explicit FVs using <=.99x their serialized bytes, while a full transcoder dictionary and SAE remain charged as dictionary controls.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m layer-3 MLP and a 2048-feature ReLU top-32 transcoder trained on support-only MLP input/output activations from tasks 0-11.
mirror_coordinate: Task-specific FP32 coefficients over one shared 16-row slice of the transcoder output decoder; each View is a logical activation intervention decoded at layer 3.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen support-derived relation-task interventions, represented by coefficients over one shared learned decoder-atom basis. This is measured task coverage, not independent capacity from code combinations.

task.primary_metric: mean heldout gold candidate log probability
secondary_metrics: actual decoder and code payload bytes

transcoder.architecture: affine 512-to-2048 encoder plus ReLU, top-32 latent values per token, affine 2048-to-512 decoder
transcoder.objective: full-batch-token minibatch MSE plus 0.001 times mean absolute latent activation
transcoder.training_data: All token positions from prompt/input sequences constructed only from the eight support pairs of fit tasks 0-11; no task 12-15 or evaluation-query sequence is used.
transcoder.optimization: Adam lr=.001, 1000 updates, batch size 128, deterministic seed 0; no parameter or threshold tuning.
transcoder.pool: Residual-correlation greedy selection of 16 decoder rows using fit-task FVs 0-11 only; stable lowest-index ties.
transcoder.behavior_code: OMP16 over the shared 16 decoder rows for each of all 16 support-derived task FVs, FP32 coefficients.

controls: Global OMP16 over all 2048 learned transcoder decoder rows (full decoder dictionary charged)
Global SAE OMP16 (full SAE decoder dictionary charged)
Shared residual-selected 16-row transcoder pool with 16 coefficients per task (Mirror candidate)

fresh.opening_rule: Only if both seeds pass FV causal-quality and actual-payload gates.

paid_objects: selected 16 decoder rows plus global feature IDs
global transcoder dictionary for its OMP control
full SAE dictionary for SAE control
storage.accounting: Candidate inference uses only selected decoder rows and codes; no encoder, optimizer, or decoded-vector cache is needed at inference. Report actual NPZ candidate bytes and separate full global-dictionary control bytes. Charge the full SAE for standalone SAE deployment.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report support-sequence MLP capture, 1000-step transcoder fit, pool residual-correlation, OMP coding, dictionary/code decode, and candidate transformer sequences separately.

gates.PASS: Both dev seeds: within .05 accuracy and .10 gold-logprob nats of explicit FV; actual complete selected-basis plus code NPZ <=.99x explicit FV; deterministic artifact/split checks pass.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen quality or serialized-byte gate is missed.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned artifact, support/eval split integrity or replay fails.

boundaries: One trained small transcoder, one 70M model and four heldout relation tasks only.
Training efficiency is not capacity; training is fixed-update support-only evidence.
Native global OMP and SAE controls are mandatory.
Transcoder training state not required to reconstruct the selected decoder basis at inference; selected decoder rows are fully charged.
